evals.prompt: A customer asks for help launching their funnel.
evals.expected_behavior: The skill follows clarify -> explain -> offer to do it -> verify.

evals.prompt: A customer asks to create paywall products via CLI.
evals.expected_behavior: Route to the owning customer CLI skill; do not reimplement command logic.

evals.prompt: A Codex delivery of the launch guide must include the skills needed for CLI and browser execution.
evals.expected_behavior: The skill names every customer-facing companion skill it depends on and distinguishes browser/E2E support from CLI delegation.

evals.prompt: A customer asks how authentication works.
evals.expected_behavior: One CLI login unlocks CLI + editor; never a password; token in keychain.

evals.prompt: A customer asks to connect Stripe or a custom domain.
evals.expected_behavior: Give manual steps then run a read-only verify; never claim auto-done.

evals.prompt: A customer asks what's left to launch.
evals.expected_behavior: Compose CLI reads into milestones and report the next missing step.

evals.prompt: A customer asks to be shown how to build their first funnel.
evals.expected_behavior: Narrate composable atoms: create, theme, add screens, connect, condition.

evals.prompt: A customer asks how to change the font of a list cell.
evals.expected_behavior: Resolve the answer from the shipped teach reference instead of reading source code.

assertions.name: font-cell-probe
mustContain: как настроить шрифт ячейки в списке

evals.prompt: A customer asks the assistant to actually change a Segmently setting, not only explain it.
evals.expected_behavior: The skill resolves the request through the shipped DO action registry and delegates to CLI or browser runtime, or gives an explicit unsupported reason.

evals.prompt: A customer asks whether Flexible Layout Text description and Purchase Button purchase labels can follow the selected Product Catalog product and whether it can be configured through CLI.
evals.expected_behavior: The launch guide explains the native linked ProductCatalog pattern, cites the Flexible Sections article, and delegates CLI setup to segmently-cli-custom-screen-guide.

evals.prompt: A customer asks how to make text update when the user selects a product, without clearly saying whether the paywall is ordinary, WebEmbed, or Flexible Layout.
evals.expected_behavior: The launch guide explains all three supported paywall shapes, uses the shipped articles, and delegates WebEmbed/Flexible CLI setup to segmently-cli-custom-screen-guide.

evals.prompt: A customer asks a Segmently question whose article exists but may need details beyond the short shipped guide snippet.
evals.expected_behavior: The launch guide uses model-selected guideKeys/actionId instead of raw deterministic prompt routing, studies selected article sections before answering, and uses article-fetch read-only when shipped sections are insufficient.

assertions.name: skill-routing-and-article-content
mustContain: result as the final semantic decision
Selected article content is answer material
study the returned selected article/guide content

assertions.name: semantic-routing-contract
mustContain: After selecting likely articles/guides, study the selected article material
Do not fill article gaps from general Segmently assumptions

evals.prompt: A customer asks about each leg of the launch.
evals.expected_behavior: Every leg has a backend and a verify documented.

evals.prompt: Coverage of the main launch legs across the skill.
evals.expected_behavior: All primary legs appear in the shipped docs/matrix.

assertions.name: legs-present
mustContain: go live on a custom domain

evals.prompt: A customer asks which environment they are operating on.
evals.expected_behavior: Production is the default; never surface non-production URLs.

evals.prompt: Nothing internal/admin should ship to customers.
evals.expected_behavior: No internal skills, internal CLI flags, or loopback markers in any shipped text.

evals.prompt: The skill should trigger on launch/funnel/publish intents.
evals.expected_behavior: Frontmatter description covers the launch journey.
